items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution and Privilege Escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch customer sessions, escalate privileges, and potentially achieve remote code execution. Exploitation attempts have been observed in the wild.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities (Arbitrary Code Execution, File System Write, DoS, Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-34645, CVE-2026-34646, and CVE-2026-34656, that could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system write, application denial-of-service, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities (Security Feature Bypass, DoS, Privilege Escalation, RCE, File Read)
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass, application denial-of-service, privilege escalation, arbitrary code execution, and arbitrary file system read.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security-Feature Bypass (unauthenticated)
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability allows a security-feature bypass without requiring authentication or administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution (authenticated admin)
items.summary: This stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution (authenticated)
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security-Feature Bypass (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Critical Vulnerability leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving a critical vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Auth Bypass)
items.summary: This critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass authorization controls and gain unauthorized write access without user interaction. It has a CVSS base score of 7.5.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered this critical flaw in Magento's REST API, enabling unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9, but older versions remain vulnerable.
